prs.title: feat(web): cached user profiles with team and avatar
prs.body:
Profiles now load instantly on revisit and show the user's team and avatar.

## Changes

- `getUser` takes a required `GetUserOptions` argument (`include`, `fresh`, `signal`); all callers updated
- Move `ApiError`, auth headers and error parsing into `api/errors.ts` and add `isNotFound`
- Add `useProfileCache`: stale-while-revalidate cache with a 5 minute TTL and request de-duplication
- Add `Avatar` and `ProfileHeader` components; `ProfilePage` uses the cache and shows save errors
- Invalidate the profile cache on logout
- server: return `avatarUrl` when `include=avatar` is requested

## Breaking

`getUser(id)` is now `getUser(id, opts)`; pass `{}` for the old behaviour.
prs.author: alice

prs.title: refactor(web): rename fetchJSON to requestJSON
prs.body:
The helper sends every method, not just GETs, and the old name kept leading people to call `fetch()` directly for writes.

## Changes

- Rename `fetchJSON` to `requestJSON` in `api/client.ts`
- Update every import and call site (19 files)

Pure rename, no behaviour change.
prs.author: fredric

prs.title: chore(billing): remove legacy finance export and dead helpers
prs.body:
Finance moved to the ledger API in 2024 and the 2023 reconciliation is closed.

## Changes

- Delete `server/internal/billing/legacy.go` (`LegacyExport`, `WriteLegacyCSV`, `parseLegacyDate`)
- Remove `renumberLegacy` from `invoice.go`
- Remove `legacyTaxCents` and the now-unused `math` import from `tax.go`
prs.author: bob

prs.title: feat(server): user preferences API and ops health check
prs.body:
Per-user preferences (theme and email digest), behind a switch while the settings page catches up.

## Changes

- Migration `20261010_user_preferences.sql`: new `user_preferences` table, `users.avatar_url` column (for #101), drop the unused `users.legacy_theme` column
- `GET` and `PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/preferences`, enabled with `PORTAL_PREFERENCES_API=on`
- `users.Routes` takes the preferences store and the switch; `main` and tests updated
- Health checks move from `GET /api/v1/health` to `GET /healthz` on the ops listener (`PORTAL_OPS_ADDR`, default `:9090`)
- Settings page: theme picker behind the `user-preferences-v2` flag
prs.author: dana
